name: Example: weekly status note
description: Finds what changed in the folder this week, drafts a short status note, and stops for a person to check it.

inputs.name: week_ending
inputs.label: Week ending
inputs.help: The Friday the note covers, as YYYY-MM-DD.

stages.title: Find what changed
stages.instruction: List the files in the working folder that changed in the week ending on the week_ending input, with one line each on what changed. Read only what you need.

stages.title: Draft the note
stages.instruction: Write a status note of at most ten lines for the audience input, from the earlier stage's list. Plain language, no file paths. Put the note itself in your result.

checklist.text: Every point in the note is true
Anything to add before it goes out?
